name: Kilandra
about: Kilandra (class 1040, map 4), whose daughter Elaina lies in the Cemetery (specs/world/leveling_facts.md 8.2: G[264:1] after 'Your daughter?!', G[220:1] when her grave is read). Virtues topic (Honor, 2026-11-08): the promise to visit the grave (mark kilandra_promise; deed kilandra_promise_kept).

topics.label: Elaina
say: Elaina. I have not said her name aloud in a long time.

topics.label: I will go to Elaina's grave for you, and see that it is not forgotten. You have my word.
say: You would do that? For a stranger's child?
Then go, and come back and tell me. I will not hope too much. But I will hope a little.

topics.label: I am sorry for your loss.
say: Thank you. It was long ago.

topics.label: The dead are dead. Stop wallowing.
say: Kilandra looks at you as if you had struck her.
